core_categories: Medical Equipment; Pharmaceuticals; Diagnostic and Lab Equipment; Home and Personal Care; Surgical and Clinical Gear
specialty_focus: MediWorld is a UK-based international supplier, trader, and distributor of medical equipment, pharmaceuticals, and healthcare products. It specializes in regulatory-compliant medical logistics, bulk medical supplies, and support for clinical diagnostics, patient home-monitoring, and institutional healthcare procurement. It distributes a range of medical devices including blood pressure monitors and defibrillators, but does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
